question: After final CI completes, should this maintainer-requested renderer split be accepted once a redacted real web-chat smoke demonstrates unchanged transcript, media, and action behavior?
rationale: The patch deliberately moves security- and lifecycle-sensitive rendering code without intended visual changes, so automated coverage alone does not establish the full interactive UI contract.

options.title: Request live web-chat proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted after-fix chat run that exercises a representative message group and one media or action path before merging.

options.title: Accept test-only refactor evidence
options.body: Merge based on the focused tests and CI if the responsible maintainer confirms that a live UI proof would add no meaningful assurance.

recommendation.title: Request live web-chat proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted after-fix chat run that exercises a representative message group and one media or action path before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies steipete as the contributor responsible for the requested renderer split and its supplied validation evidence.
